# Policy case rows: slice 2

Authority: USER ruling #2287/6198217322; reviewer-d gates 6198273266,
6200951982 and 6207943492. The restarted scheduling permission does not
unpark #2577 or change B's #2698 reservation.

## Owner and bounded change

`projectNodePolicyCaseValue` admits exactly singular selector/scalar equals
or plural selector/equals lists of equal length at least two. Case-only
helpers retain source coordinates and reject blank members before lowering.
The shared range/lookup string-list reader is unchanged. A structurally keyed
pair of normalized path and existing lowered typed literal detects identical
pairs within one tuple without numeric coercion, sorting or selector-only
uniqueness. `validatePolicySheetRows` still independently owns duplicate
ordered whole tuples across rows and the required trailing default.

## Live-source census and hosted reach

The base is 9beb615299e14741752ea6c92128b8e6036e9ee6. Repository-wide Go/YAML
searches for case/selector/selectors were reviewed by semantic context, not
counted as all policy rows: `case` entity declarations, entity-write grants,
CLI selectors and error prose are not case admission consumers. No authored
YAML policy-case fixture needs migration. Existing plural positive fixtures
in workflow_contract_yaml_test.go and workflow_contract_rule_presentation_test.go
already have matching lists of length two. The only old alternate-acceptance
fixture is the generated W4 presence table: its case.selectors row now proves
the real two-member tuple, and its singular case.equals sequence cell refuses.
All eight presence shapes remain exercised. Shared range/lookup rows are intact.

New negatives are explicitly test-only. The original three-entrance RED at
166932d6ec is retained in #2287/6207919132, with a backed-up signed source ref.
The canonical registry's historical corpus counts and all historical codemod
recipes/pins remain unchanged. The existing policy-selection row records the
shape and distinct same-row/across-row duplicate rulings.

Hosted selection: lifecycle plus core-structural-owner-guards, as reviewer-d
ruled. Changed executable families are contracts, CLI verify and engine, plus
the existing bootverify consumers and registry/spec guards. There are no new
full-only fixture migrations, planner edits, timeouts or placement changes.
Before the PR push, record exact-head focused/guard, plan-census and preflight
